question_text: A scientist measured the pressure in a phloem tube in a willow plant stem. He repeated his measurements to obtain nine readings. His results are shown in Table 3. The percentage error of the mean phloem pressure in this phloem tube is calculated using this equation. Percentage error = uncertainty in measurement / mean × 100 The uncertainty in measurement is half the range of the measured values. Calculate the percentage error of the mean phloem pressure in this phloem tube. Show your working.

points.text: Accept for 1 mark, mean = 8.2 OR uncertainty = 1.15
